actual_source.scope: Latest maintained own VA/DIL with isolated cache-only observation. Original Kodi/App FFmpeg, input and discard/scheduling policy unchanged. Diagnostic results cannot qualify stock compatibility or release acceptance.

module_artifact_reuse.scope: Exact reviewed artifact reused; not relabelled as a new kernel build. Full matched official1.3/source24a/module20 cohort and original module inventory restored after each case.

input.route: Same-PID two natural EOF/reopen plays, Centered1280x720 in FHD NV12 and actual software BWDIF; original frozen plan and four audits unchanged.

public_setup_observation.scope: All seven calls uniquely contained in the first EndPicture body on the same PID/TID. Setup sum is within each body, never across separate cases.

rx_observation.scope: All16 REGISTER and one START_RX_CAP events per play uniquely contained in the actual same-TID DtsStartCapture. Raw ioctl spans exclude mincore. Outer call includes mincore and observer overhead. Page totals are sums of per-buffer coverage observations, not distinct physical-page counts.

source_review.actual_default_rx_allocator: Fresh current O2 disassembly folds fixed RX malloc+memset into calloc(0x3fde00,1),16 buffers. Legal compiler behavior; it does not guarantee prefaulted resident private backing.
source_review.retained_registration: One crystalhd_map_dio per REGISTER; writable long-term pin, SG build/DMA map and RX descriptor submission. No full RX payload clear/copy in this path. DIO/SG arrays and rings are allocated before registration.
source_review.previous_finite_wait0_fix: Already implemented by#666; not a newly found cause

controls.cpu_wrapper: Five CPU-only modes PASS: exact forwarding/status/errno+selection, fork, overflow, cold/warm residency, invalid/unmapped mincore. Actual DIL binding/publication established by separate physical observation.
controls.build: Fresh strict normal O2 DIL plus explicit --wrap=ioctl object; existing VA observer recipe plus seven nonweak public call wraps. No external source/product edits or preload rewrite.
controls.initial_probe_build_failure: Missing 7411d.h prerequisite caused a cache-only compile error; corrected include order. Original failed build log preserved; no runtime/product failure inferred.
controls.independent_source_review: DIL probe and retirement publisher reviewed independently; original controller module actions, ownership and restoration unchanged.

interpretation: First-body setup cost is localized into public OPEN/START/CAPTURE calls. The 16-buffer REGISTER phase accounts for nearly all measured capture cost; final START_RX_CAP is under0.1ms in both RX observations.
Many registered page ranges are nonresident before REGISTER and fully resident afterward. This is a bounded residency transition, not an isolated pin/GUP timing or proof of writable backing.
Both cases retain strict Source900 failures. All admitted originals still complete their genuine field/release/materialization paths under the unchanged audits.

No redundant RX clear/copy, own functional defect, source-loss causal correction, matched speedup or general impossibility is demonstrated. No speculative prefault, reduced default buffers, weakened DMA/pin/ownership guards or external patch is shipped.
next_boundary: If pursuing this startup cost, distinguish writable page pin from SG/DMA/descriptor work at the owned kernel boundary, then require a demonstrated semantics-preserving correction and matched benefit. Repeating Source900 counts or moving identical work earlier does not prove a fix.
